overview.title: Why consider OpenPanel over Smartlook?
paragraphs: Smartlook combined product analytics with visual insights: session recordings, heatmaps and event tracking in one platform. Cisco acquired it in 2023 and is now winding it down as a standalone product. Smartlook stopped selling new subscriptions on 31 May 2026, stops renewals on 31 August 2026, ends support on 31 August 2027 and decommissions the platform on 30 September 2027. Its functions move to Digital Experience Analytics in Splunk Observability Cloud, and Splunk will not migrate historical data.

OpenPanel delivers event tracking, funnels, retention analysis, cohort breakdowns and session replay in a focused, open-source package. The result is a tool that covers both product analytics and visual session review at a flat, event-based price starting at $2.50 per month.

Being open source under the AGPL-3.0 license gives OpenPanel advantages that Smartlook's proprietary, Cisco-owned platform can't match. You can self-host on your own infrastructure for complete data sovereignty, audit the source code for security compliance, and avoid the vendor lock-in risk that comes with acquisition-prone platforms. Self-hosting also means unlimited data retention, compared to Smartlook's plan-based limits.

If you need advanced heatmaps or Unity analytics, look at Splunk or a dedicated heatmap tool. For teams that want product analytics plus session replay with open-source transparency, self-hosting and predictable pricing, OpenPanel is a place to land before the Smartlook shutdown.

migration.title: Migrating from Smartlook to OpenPanel
migration.intro: Smartlook is shutting down, so this move is a question of when. OpenPanel keeps session replay and product analytics while adding self-hosting, open source and flat pricing.

steps.title: Export what you want to keep
steps.description: Splunk will not migrate Smartlook data. Export event data and any recordings you need before your subscription ends; everything is deleted on 30 September 2027.

steps.title: Create OpenPanel account or self-host
steps.description: Sign up for OpenPanel cloud or deploy self-hosted using Docker. Configure your project settings.

steps.title: Install OpenPanel SDK
steps.description: Replace the Smartlook snippet with OpenPanel's SDK. Install via npm or use the CDN. For mobile apps, install the appropriate native SDK.

steps.title: Map events and properties
steps.description: Convert Smartlook's event tracking to OpenPanel's event structure. Set up user identification using identify() to track users across sessions.

steps.title: Build analytics dashboards
steps.description: Create funnels, retention charts, and cohort analyses in OpenPanel to replace Smartlook's analytics.

sdk_compatibility.notes: Both use similar event tracking APIs. Main difference is OpenPanel doesn't automatically record sessions.

historical_data.notes: Smartlook recordings cannot be imported anywhere. Export event data through Smartlook before your subscription ends, and run both tools in parallel while OpenPanel builds history.

faqs.title: Frequently asked questions
faqs.intro: Common questions about switching from Smartlook to OpenPanel.

items.question: Can OpenPanel replace Smartlook's session recordings?
items.answer: For session replay, yes: OpenPanel records sessions when you enable it and shows them next to the session's events. It has no heatmaps, frustration signals or Unity analytics.

items.question: Which tool has better funnel analysis?
items.answer: Both tools offer funnel analysis. With OpenPanel you can also watch session recordings of users who dropped off, and OpenPanel offers more advanced funnel customization and cohort breakdowns.

items.question: Can I self-host Smartlook?
items.answer: No, Smartlook is only available as a cloud-hosted service (now part of Cisco). OpenPanel offers both cloud hosting and self-hosted deployment via Docker for complete data ownership.

items.question: What happened with Cisco acquiring Smartlook?
items.answer: Cisco completed the acquisition in June 2023. In 2026 Smartlook announced it is winding down as a standalone product: end of sale on 31 May 2026, no renewals after 31 August 2026, last day of support 31 August 2027, and decommissioning on 30 September 2027. Its functions continue inside Splunk Observability Cloud as Digital Experience Analytics, and historical data is not migrated.

items.question: How does pricing compare?
items.answer: Smartlook no longer sells subscriptions, so there is no price to compare. Existing paid plans end by 31 August 2027. OpenPanel uses flat event-based tiers from $2.50/month for 5,000 events (30-day trial), and self-hosting is free with unlimited events.

items.question: Does OpenPanel support mobile apps?
items.answer: Yes. OpenPanel has Swift (iOS), Kotlin (Android) and React Native SDKs for event tracking; session replay is web only. Smartlook additionally supported Unity, Cordova and Xamarin with mobile replay.
